meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 它会引导你建好第一个 NanoClaw agent:确认你在频道里的身份、把私聊消息组绑到这个 agent,并让 agent 通过正常投递链路给你发一条欢迎私信。每一步都可重复运行。
howto.when: 当你配好频道凭证、服务正在运行,并至少装好一个 /add-<channel>(如 Discord、Telegram 等)之后使用。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 频道建第一个 agent,并让它给我发欢迎私信
say.note: 它会先问频道,再要你的用户 id 和显示名

say.text: 我的 Telegram 用户 id 是 12345,显示名 Li,帮我接入私聊
say.note: 可走 telegram 配对码,不必先私聊机器人

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到,帮我查 outbound.db 里有没有卡住的 pending

howto.what_en: Walks you through creating your first NanoClaw agent: it resolves your channel identity, wires a DM messaging group to a new agent, and has the agent send you a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, and at least one /add-<channel> skill (Discord, Telegram, etc.) has been installed.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent on my Discord channel and have it send me a welcome DM
say_en.note: It asks for the channel, then your user id and display name

say_en.text: My Telegram user id is 12345, display name Li — wire up the DM agent
say_en.note: Can use the Telegram pair code instead of DMing the bot first

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived — check outbound.db for stuck pending rows
say_en.note: It checks outbound.db and nanoclaw.log to diagnose
